items.mainDefect: Non-atomic backup-code consumption lets concurrent logins reuse the same single-use code.

secondary.defect: Consumed codes remain as null entries, so an exhausted array never triggers MissingBackupCodes.

items.mainDefect: Direct backup-code comparisons in the login path leak timing information.

secondary.defect: Backup-code verification fails for equivalent uppercase input because hex case is not normalized.
